rows.title: The germinal products overview page, its section 2 tasks, its two total cards and its named regions
rows.detail: A germinal products notification gets an overview page of its own in the germinal products set, a copy of the live animals overview with the germinal differences. Its section 2 lists Commodity details, then Identification details where a chosen commodity needs identifiers, and nothing else: the germinal set has no additional details page, and the total gross weight is asked per species on Commodity details. 'Your commodities' shows two total cards, the quantity in units or pieces and the number of packages, each a region named for what it counts, and the page's blocks are regions named by their own headings.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification has an overview page of its own in the germinal products set, keyed by that notification as the live animals overview is, showing the heading 'Overview', the notification's status and reference, the 'Notification task list' heading with its numbered sections, and the buttons 'Review and submit' then 'Return to dashboard'. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-008, -p1-009, -p1-011, -p1-012, -p1-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-056; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-001; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p4-001)

A germinal products notification's overview has the browser page title 'Overview - Import notification service - GOV.UK'. (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p4-001; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-001)

A germinal products notification's overview has no serious or critical WCAG 2.2 A or AA accessibility violations, both with the totals at zero and with quantities and packages entered. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-001)

On a germinal products notification's overview, section 2 holds 'Commodity details', then 'Identification details' where a chosen commodity needs identifiers, and no other task. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-059; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-048; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-004; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-020)

On a germinal products notification's overview, 'Your commodities' shows exactly two cards, in this order: a card labelled 'Units/pieces' with the caption 'Total quantity in this consignment', then a card labelled 'Packages/boxes' with the caption 'Total number of packages in this consignment'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-115, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-115-m1, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-119; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-056; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023; ruling:ian-2026-11-11 ruling-ian-2026-11-11-p1-013)

With two germinal commodity lines holding quantities 12 and 8 and numbers of packages 3 and 1, the 'Units/pieces' card reads '20' and the 'Packages/boxes' card reads '4'. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-056; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-116, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-117)

On a germinal products notification's overview, both cards read '0' before any commodity line has a quantity or a number of packages. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-116, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-117)

The overview's 'Units/pieces' card adds up only the saved quantities that are positive numbers, and reads '0' when that total is not above zero. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-116; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-056; ruling:ian-2026-11-11 ruling-ian-2026-11-11-p1-013, -p1-015)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Units/pieces' card is a region named 'Quantity summary' and the 'Packages/boxes' card is a region named 'Packages summary'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-115, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-117; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-008; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-044)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Your commodities' block, the task list and each numbered task section are regions named by their own heading. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-115; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-008)
A live animals notification's overview shows exactly two cards: 'Animals' then 'Packages/boxes'. (trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p4-008)
rows.notes: Combines five thin slices of the one germinal overview page: the page itself (req-1836), its section 2 tasks (req-2746), its cards (req-788), their total (req-2745) and its named regions (req-1837). Building them apart would copy the same page five times and repeat the same set-up, review and ladder. 11 criteria. The existing row also carries the commodities area's Commodity details completeness rule (req-1763); the combiner keeps those criteria beside these. c-128 ruled by precedence: each set keeps a per-notification overview in its own path shape, so no criterion names a path. c-244 ruled by precedence: the 'Units/pieces' and 'Packages/boxes' cards and no weight card. c-486 ruled by precedence: the owner's 27 November decision keeps total gross weight per species on Commodity details, so section 2 has no gross weight task. The 'Units/pieces' total reads each germinal commodity line's quantity in units or pieces, which the commodities area builds in the same theme. The live animals criterion is a regression check on a page this row does not change. The germinal set does not exist yet: this page is a copy of the live animals overview, taken after the overview-and-review split theme has changed that hub, which owns frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub; this row touches only the germinal set's own hub folder, so it is not that branch's work. Observable the same way in stub mode and on the compose stack.

rows.title: The germinal products overview shows the Transit countries task for a rail or road journey
rows.detail: A germinal products notification travelling by rail or road is asked its transit countries, so its overview lists a Transit countries task in the transport and arrival section between Arrival details and Transport details while that applies, complete once a country is added.
acceptanceCriteria: A germinal products notification's overview shows a 'Transit countries' task between 'Arrival details' and 'Transport details' while its saved means of transport is Rail or Road, reading 'To do' with no country added and 'Complete' once one is. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-060; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, -p1-057)

When transit countries are required for a germinal products notification, as for a road or rail journey, its overview's '3. Transport and arrival' section lists 'Arrival details', then 'Transit countries', then 'Transport details'; for an air or sea journey it lists 'Arrival details', then 'Transport details'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-060; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-019; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)
rows.notes: One slice: the germinal overview's Transit countries task. Draft of the notification-hub half of the existing row that builds the germinal transit countries page (req-2631, arrival-and-transit area); the combiner keeps it there, since the task reads the page and the rail-or-road rule that row builds. The rule that decides when transit countries are required belongs to the arrival-and-transit area. The live twin of the page sits in the arrival-and-transit split theme, but this row touches only the germinal set's own folders, so it is not that branch's work. Observable the same way in stub mode and on the compose stack.

rows.title: The germinal products overview's Addresses section holds one Consignment addresses task
rows.detail: The germinal products set asks only the five consignment addresses, with no county parish holding number and no permanent address, so its overview's Addresses section holds a single Consignment addresses task, with the same hint as live animals, complete once the five addresses are given.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification's overview, the fifth section heading reads '5. Addresses' and that section holds one task, titled 'Consignment addresses'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-121; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-053)

The 'Consignment addresses' task on a germinal products notification's overview shows the hint 'Consignor or Exporter, Consignee, Importer and Place of Destination' under its link. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-035-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p6-059; ruling:sam-2026-11-17 ruling-sam-2026-11-17-p1-016)

On a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Consignment addresses' task reads 'Complete' once all five consignment addresses are given, and 'To do' while any of them is missing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, -p1-018; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p5-053)
rows.notes: One slice: the germinal overview's Addresses task. Draft of the notification-hub half of the existing row that builds the germinal consignment addresses page and its pickers; the combiner keeps it there, since the task reads the page that row builds. c-405 ruled by precedence: the owner's 17 November decision fixes the wording as '5. Addresses' and 'Consignment addresses'. The task covers the five consignment addresses only, because the germinal set has no county parish holding number or permanent address page. The live twin sits in the consignment-parties split theme, but this row touches only the germinal set's own folders. Observable the same way in stub mode and on the compose stack.
